subject: Stitching demo around CTO transit - pause & reconvene plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Reilly <liam@stratasec.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Asha Venkataraman <asha@stratasec.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stitching demo around CTO transit: very short window on Tuesday

Hi Soojin / Asha,

Quick heads up — our CTO will be landing Tuesday afternoon and only has a 25-minute window between back-to-back airport commitments and an all-hands. We still want Redwood to run the product walkthrough, but we're trying to figure out a practical way to get both an executive-level touchpoint and the deeper technical demo without asking the CTO for extra time.

Two possible approaches from our side:
- Option A: Run a 20-minute executive brief during the CTO's 25-minute window (high level value + 1 quick Q&A) and reconvene the full technical deep-dive with your engineering team later that week.
- Option B: Move the full demo completely to a different day when the CTO can join for 45–60 minutes.

Can you share what would be least disruptive on your side? We have the pre-demo deck attached for context.

Thanks,
Liam
Director of IT Strategy
StrataSec

Attachment: pre-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 3 slides)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Reilly <liam@stratasec.com>, Asha Venkataraman <asha@stratasec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stitching demo around CTO transit: very short window on Tuesday

Thanks for the note, Liam — and appreciate the deck.

We can absolutely accommodate Option A (20-minute executive brief + separate deep-dive). To make that work cleanly I propose the following lightweight playbook:

1) Tuesday (CTO window): 20-minute "spotlight" — 12 min presentation (value props + one quick live example), 6 min for CTO questions. Our goal is to leave the CTO with clear next steps and a scheduled deep-dive.
2) Deep-dive later that week (recommended same-week for momentum): 60 minutes with an engineer + product PM to walk architecture, integrations, and performance numbers.

Proposed deep-dive slots (Pacific):
- Thu Jun 24, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu Jun 24, 3:00–4:00 PM PT
- Fri Jun 25, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

If the CTO truly only has 10 minutes, we can compress the Tuesday slot to a 10-minute intro + put the CTO questions into an async doc for the deep-dive. Marissa will coordinate the calendar and Kimberly is looping in engineering coverage.

I'll mark the mutual action plan with a tentative placeholder (attached). If you confirm Option A + a preferred deep-dive slot, we'll send an updated calendar invite and the brief run-of-show.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Reilly <liam@stratasec.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stitching demo around CTO transit: very short window on Tuesday

Looping in briefly — thumbs up on Option A. Two small asks from the delivery side:

- Marissa, can you confirm an engineer (preferably Alex or Mateo) who can take the deep-dive slot? We need someone who can speak to latency/cost and integration nuances.
- If the CTO only has 10 minutes, we'll prepare a 3-bullet FAQ (answers + links) so the CTO doesn't have to sit through the full Q&A.

I'll leave calendar logistics to Soojin/Marissa. Good plan.

K
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Reilly <liam@stratasec.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Venkataraman <asha@stratasec.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stitching demo around CTO transit: very short window on Tuesday

Perfect — Option A works for us. Please lock Thu Jun 24, 10:00–11:00 AM PT for the deep-dive. For Tuesday's CTO window, he can do 20 minutes but asks that we focus tightly on the "security + cost" highlights and one live demo of inference latency.

We'll accept the run-of-show and the 3-bullet FAQ approach if you need to shorten it further. You have permission to share the pre-demo deck with the internal engineer.

See you Tuesday for the brief.

Thanks,
Liam
